# Three.js Official Docs — Provenance

Three.js itself provides official docs and examples rather than a first-party agent-skill bundle.

- Docs: https://threejs.org/docs/
- Manual: https://threejs.org/manual/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three

Local adapter: `skills/09-threejs-landing-visuals/SKILL.md`.

Use the official docs for exact API signatures, current loader import paths, renderer options, material APIs, examples, and release migration notes. Do not treat older tutorials as source of truth when official docs or the migration guide differ.
